en: Black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing rolling fields, scattered farmhouses and barns, tree‑lined roads, and low forested hills. In the foreground are fields, bushes, and telephone poles; in the distance are clustered farm buildings on gentle slopes. Text is printed along the bottom margin with a serial number and a Norwegian caption identifying the location, plus a handwritten photographer/publisher signature at the lower right.
